Technical settings
Quest Enabled
Additional Quests Redux
Lets village notables offer the Bandit Army quest. Quests already offered or accepted are not affected. [Default: enabled]
Remove minimum troop requirement
Removes the minimum requirement of 50 troops to start the Bandit Army quest. [Default: disabled]
Bandit Army Size
Changes the size of the bandit army party. Applies to bandit armies spawned after the change. [Default: 100%]
Lets village notables offer the Militia Spears quest. Quests already offered or accepted are not affected. [Default: enabled]
Lets town merchants offer the Starving Town quest. Quests already offered or accepted are not affected. [Default: enabled]
Lets town merchants offer the Long Distance Caravan quest. Quests already offered or accepted are not affected. [Default: enabled]
Lets lords offer the Fund the Walls quest for their towns and castles. Quests already offered or accepted are not affected. [Default: enabled]
Lets lords offer the Donate Elite Rangers quest for their towns and castles. Quests already offered or accepted are not affected. [Default: enabled]
Logging for debugging
Logging for debugging (English only). [Default: disabled]
AI lords get quest rewards
When an AI lord resolves one of these quests, the lord gets the gold, renown and relation a player would get, and the village or town gets the same benefits. [Default: enabled]
AI lords get vanilla quest rewards
When an AI lord resolves a vanilla quest, the lord gets the quest's gold reward, some renown and better relation with the quest giver, and the quest giver gains power. [Default: enabled]
Your clan is now at war with the {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK}'s lord. Your agreement with {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} was canceled.
{SETTLEMENT_NAME} was raided by someone else. Your agreement with {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} was canceled.
Bandit Army Heading to {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}!
A bandit army is heading to {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} for a raid. The people of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} need help defending themselves.

Dire news has reached me, my scouts say that an army of rabble led by a self-proclaimed bandit "king" are making their way to our village right now, intent on taking everything we have. I've sent word to our nobles for help but I fear it may be too late by the time they get here.
That is troubling news, how will you defend yourselves?

Our militia will fight for our homes, but the more people we have the better. The enemy will be mostly comprised of rabble, just looters looking for easy money but they will have some better trained bandits as well. Will you help us defend the village?
Yes, I will help defend the village.
I heard that an army of bandits are heading their way here right now! We need to run, or hide or-or anything but stay here! Please, you must help us!

The village of {QUEST_SETTLEMENT} is about to be raided by a bandit army from a nearby hideout! {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} has asked you to stop the bandits from devastating the village.{newline}{newline}Stop the bandits from reaching {QUEST_SETTLEMENT}.
The bandit army is raiding {QUEST_SETTLEMENT}! Protect the villagers!
You have defeated the bandit army that was going to raid {QUEST_SETTLEMENT}. The villagers are very grateful. The faction ruling the village have awarded you a bounty for defending the village.
You've failed to stop the bandit army. The bandits ravaged {QUEST_SETTLEMENT} and left.
You have taken too long to defeat the bandit army. Fortunately, the nobles ruling {QUEST_SETTLEMENT} have been able to respond in time. Your agreement was canceled.
The bandit army heading to {QUEST_SETTLEMENT} was destroyed by someone else. Your agreement with {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} was canceled.
Thank you. The bandits are on their way from a hideout close by. My scouts will show you where it is. We will pray for your success.
I don't think they'll be long now. I hope you can stop them in time.
Don't worry, we will crush their "army".
Good, good. Thank you again.
Who the hell are you? This 'ere is an army, we're on our way to a village to collect some "taxes". If you know what's good for you, you'll stay outta our way!
You won't be raiding around here anytime soon, we're here to stop you!
Direction to Bandits
{QUEST_GIVER.NAME} has marked the bandit hideout. The bandit army will head from there to the village.
{BANDIT_CULTURE} Army
{ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} Needs Spears for Militia
The headman of {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT} needs spears for the militia.
I'm currently organizing the militia of the village, however we lack weapons to train and fight with. In particular, we have very few spears in the armoury.
How can I help?

I can handle training my people into militia fighters, but I need someone to find spears to fight with. You can buy them in the surrounding towns. You can even make your own, if you are a decent smith. We will need {SPEARS_AMOUNT} spears in total. I will pay you {REWARD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} for the spears.
I will find the spears you need.

The young'uns of the village have all signed up to the newly forming militia. But I heard {QUEST_GIVER.NAME} doesn't have enough spears for even half of the men to train with, so they've been using wooden sticks to train with. I hope they don't end up having to use those same sticks in a real fight!

{QUEST_GIVER.LINK}, a {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}headwoman{?}headman{\?} of {QUEST_SETTLEMENT} asked you to deliver {SPEARS_AMOUNT} spears to {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}him{\?} for the village militia. This will help boost the number of able militia in the village.{newline}{newline}You have agreed to bring them {SPEARS_AMOUNT} spears as soon as possible. You will be paid {REWARD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} for the spears.{newline}{newline}The spears should be one handed polearms.
You now have enough spears to complete the quest. Return to {QUEST_SETTLEMENT} to hand them over.
You have enough spears to complete the quest. Return to {QUEST_SETTLEMENT} to hand them over.
You have failed to deliver {SPEARS_AMOUNT} spears to the villagers. They won't be able to properly train their militia. The Headman is disappointed.
You have delivered {SPEARS_AMOUNT} spears to the villagers. Their militia is ready to train and defend the village. The Headman and the villagers are grateful.
Thank you, {?PLAYER.GENDER}milady{?}sir{\?}! We will make good use of these spears.
We await those spears, {?PLAYER.GENDER}milady{?}sir{\?}.
Have you brought {SPEARS_AMOUNT} spears?
Yes. Here they are.
I'm working on it.
You don't have enough spears.
Collect one handed polearms
Food Crisis in {ISSUE_SETTLEMENT}
The town of {SETTLEMENT} is starving, {MERCHANT_NAME} needs help to restock the town's food supplies.

The food situation is bad, the town is starving. We've had to ration out all the food coming into the city but it's getting harder and harder each day to put meals in front of people. If this keeps up for much longer, we will either all starve to death or the people will riot.
Can I help? I have some food to spare.

I thank you for your kindness, but we will require a larger amount of food to restock the city, enough to keep us going while we sort out the source of our food shortage. If you can supply Grain, Meat and Fish, I will pay you triple the average price for each. We will need at least {FOOD_AMOUNT} units of food in total to keep the town supplied.
I will head out to find food for the town.
I'm so hungry... oh, sorry, did I walk into you? It's been so hard lately... I haven't eaten in so long... If only someone could help {QUEST_GIVER.NAME} bring more food into town...

{QUEST_GIVER.LINK}, a merchant in the town of {QUEST_SETTLEMENT} asked you to deliver {FOOD_AMOUNT} food to the town, to help fulfil the current food crisis. The food can either be Grain, Meat or Fish.{newline}{newline}You will be paid triple the average price of each good on delivery.
You now have enough food to complete the quest. Return to {QUEST_SETTLEMENT} to hand it over.
You have enough food to complete the quest. Return to {QUEST_SETTLEMENT} to hand it over.
You have failed to deliver {FOOD_AMOUNT} food to {QUEST_SETTLEMENT}. The people continue to starve and {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} is disappointed.
You have delivered {FOOD_AMOUNT} food to {QUEST_SETTLEMENT}. The people rejoice at the delivery of food. You have saved the people from starvation.
Thank you, {?PLAYER.GENDER}milady{?}sir{\?}! This food will help us all.
We await the food supplies, {?PLAYER.GENDER}milady{?}sir{\?}.
Have you brought {FOOD_AMOUNT} food?
Yes. Here it is.
I'm working on it.
You don't have enough food.
Collect Grain/Fish/Meat.
You gave {FOOD_AMOUNT} meat. In return you got {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}.
You gave {FOOD_AMOUNT} fish. In return you got {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}.
You gave {FOOD_AMOUNT} grain. In return you got {GOLD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}.
Long Distance Caravan to {DESTINATION}
{QUEST_GIVER.NAME}, a merchant of {ORIGIN}, is sending a heavily loaded caravan to the far town of {DESTINATION} and needs a strong escort for the whole road.

The markets around here are full of goods that sell for a fortune in {DESTINATION}. I am putting most of my savings into one big caravan, but it is a long road, and a caravan that rich draws every bandit along the way.
A long road needs a strong escort. What do you propose?

Ride with my caravan all the way to {DESTINATION}. It will stop in towns along the road to rest. Keep it in sight and keep it alive. When the goods are sold, I will give you half of the profit. Bring at least {TROOP_COUNT} men, the road is dangerous.
My men are ready. Load the wagons.
They say {QUEST_GIVER.NAME} wants to send a whole fortune in goods to {DESTINATION}. A madman or a genius, if anyone can keep the bandits off it.

{QUEST_GIVER.LINK}, a merchant of {ORIGIN}, has loaded a caravan with goods worth {CARGO_VALUE}{GOLD_ICON} for the far town of {DESTINATION}. You have agreed to escort it all the way there. When the goods are sold, {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}she{?}he{\?} will give you half of the profit.
The caravan of {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} reached {DESTINATION} and sold its goods for {EARNED}{GOLD_ICON}. The trip made a profit of {PROFIT}{GOLD_ICON} and your share is {SHARE}{GOLD_ICON}.
{OLD_DESTINATION} can no longer be reached safely. The caravan is heading to {DESTINATION} instead.
No town is left where the caravan of {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} can sell its goods safely. {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\?} recalled the caravan and canceled your agreement.
Fund the Walls of {SETTLEMENT}
{QUEST_GIVER.NAME} wants the construction works in {SETTLEMENT} to go faster, but the treasury is short of coin.
The builders in {SETTLEMENT} are working too slowly. Every denar in my treasury goes to my men in the field, and the masons do not work for promises.
Perhaps I can help. What do you need?
Take {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} to {SETTLEMENT} and hand it to my steward there. With that coin the works will go much faster. I will not forget such generosity.
I will bring {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} to {SETTLEMENT}.
Thank you. My steward in {SETTLEMENT} will be expecting you.
Has the coin reached {SETTLEMENT} yet?
Not yet. I am on my way.
{QUEST_GIVER.LINK}, the {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?} of {SETTLEMENT}, asked you to fund the construction works there. Go to {SETTLEMENT} and hand over {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} to the steward.
Hand over {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} for the construction works
You handed over {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} to the steward of {SETTLEMENT}. The construction works will go faster.
You did not bring the coin to {SETTLEMENT} in time. {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} is disappointed.
Elite Rangers for {SETTLEMENT}
{QUEST_GIVER.NAME} wants {COUNT} {TROOP} to guard the walls of {SETTLEMENT}.
The walls of {SETTLEMENT} are only as strong as the bows behind them. My garrison needs real marksmen, not farm boys with hunting bows, and training such men takes years I do not have.
What kind of men do you need?
Bring {COUNT} {TROOP} to {SETTLEMENT} and leave them with the garrison. I will pay you {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} for them, more than it cost you to train them.
I will bring {COUNT} {TROOP} to {SETTLEMENT}.
Good. The garrison commander in {SETTLEMENT} will take them in.
Have you brought the {TROOP} to {SETTLEMENT}?
Not yet. Men like that are not found in every village.

{QUEST_GIVER.LINK}, the {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?} of {SETTLEMENT}, asked you to bring {COUNT} {TROOP} to the garrison there. {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\?} will pay you {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} when they are handed over.
Hand over {COUNT} {TROOP} to the garrison
You left {COUNT} {TROOP} with the garrison of {SETTLEMENT}.
You did not bring the troops to {SETTLEMENT} in time. {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} is disappointed.
You need {COUNT} healthy {TROOP} in your party.
